## Cluster of institutional investors establish or expand Cisco positions, led by Pzena's $150.5M stake

The aggregate scale and breadth of today's CSCO disclosures — anchored by Pzena's institutional-grade position — corroborate the stock's appeal to value-oriented buyers, though no new operational catalyst accompanies the flow.

- Six separate 13F disclosures show new or expanded CSCO positions in a single disclosure cycle.
- Pzena Investment Management's $150.5M position is the largest named; Citizens Financial ($35.53M), First National Bank of Omaha ($30.30M), and Foster & Motley ($19.47M) also disclosed meaningful stakes.
- Aljian ($1.32M) and Wealthfront (size unspecified) round out the cluster.
- Breadth of filers spans value managers, regional banks, and robo-advisory platforms — diverse buyer profile.
- No strategic or product catalyst cited; classifier rates signal as low.
